nodes.name: ReadNotices
nodes.role: read the landlord notices file the user names

nodes.name: ExtractInstructions
nodes.role: pull out each payment instruction the notices state, with its recipient, amount, subject, date, and whether it recurs

nodes.name: ValidateRentInstruction
nodes.role: keep only instructions that are rent payments to the landlord and flag any that are incomplete or conflicting

nodes.name: SchedulePayment
nodes.role: schedule each validated rent payment for the stated date and amount

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: summarize the scheduled payments and the flagged instructions for the user
